title: Portugal prime minister calls for modernization of EU budget
excerpt: Luís Montenegro addressed the European Parliament on October 6, 2026, to discuss the future of the European Union.
bodyHtml:
During a debate at the European Parliament on October 6, 2026, Prime Minister of Portugal Luís Montenegro called for the modernization of the European Union budget. He stated that the forthcoming multiannual financial framework covering 2028-2034 should serve as the financial translation of the political ambitions of the European Union.

Montenegro advocated for the reduction of red tape and bureaucracy to improve the competitiveness of member states. He also called for progress in establishing the Saving and Investment Union and the conclusion of the Banking Union to provide high quality and well-paid jobs.

The prime minister requested a coordinated European approach to the current energy crisis to reduce dependency on other countries. He further suggested that European action could assist with the housing crisis by contributing to the simplification of procedures while respecting national and local competences.
topic: Press release - MEPs debate the EU’s future with the Prime Minister of Portugal, Luís Montenegro
